comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening limit; PR-2256 measures brake-rotor thickness with a handheld outside micrometer and preserves the reading after removal.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires hex-driver and jam-nut-wrench countertorque; PR-2256 requires positioning a micrometer on a friction band, keeping it square, rocking for the minimum, and turning a ratchet to controlled measuring force.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained 90° gripper opening through three cycles; PR-2256 requires a reading within ±0.02 mm, two ratchet clicks, reading retention off the rotor, and released placement on the rest.
comparison.reason: Although both retain a setting, PR-2256 tests metrological contact and reading preservation, not locking a mechanical adjustment against coupled fastening reaction or verifying articulated function; its rubric is numeric.
